categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and fixes a socket-reading unit test helper in sock_tests to handle partial reads correctly.
categories.rationale: Fixes socket reading logic in a unit test to handle partial reads, preventing potential test flakiness under chunked socket delivery. As noted in the description, 'The issue is test-code only' and 'partial reads are improbable in standard CI runs on loopback' without a synthetic reproducer patch, making this a narrow, low-severity test fix.
